tasks.title: Fix proof_url not visible to HOD (relative URL bug)
tasks.description: Faculty enter Drive links without https:// prefix. The <a href> treats them as relative paths causing 404s. Fix: sanitize proof_url in DutySubmissionModal to prepend https:// if no protocol. Also auto-linkify URLs in submission_text so embedded links are clickable in ReviewPanel.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Proof links open correctly in HOD view regardless of whether faculty typed https:// or not. URLs embedded in submission text are clickable.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(academic-duties): sanitize proof_url protocol and auto-linkify submission text for HOD

tasks.title: Fix broken api.ts route handlers (split handler bug)
tasks.description: Previous route-reordering script left GET /faculty/api-scores and GET /faculty/api-duties/pending split in half — the second half of each handler is orphaned outside any app.get() callback. Also there is a 350-line duplicate block of Academic Duties v1 endpoints (lines ~10265-10610) that shadows the v2 endpoints. Fix: reconstruct both broken handlers and remove duplicate block.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Backend build exits 0. GET /faculty/api-scores returns scores array. GET /faculty/api-duties/pending returns pending duties. No duplicate route registrations.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(backend): reconstruct split route handlers and remove 350-line duplicate academic duties block

tasks.title: Fix json_agg null row bug in GET /academic-duties
tasks.description: When a duty has no assignees, LEFT JOIN returns a null row and json_agg produces [{id:null,...}] instead of []. Fix: add FILTER (WHERE ae.id IS NOT NULL) to json_agg call. Also fix frontend: duty.total shows 1 instead of 0 for empty duties.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Duties with no assignees show 0/0 progress. No phantom null rows in assignees array.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(backend): add FILTER WHERE ae.id IS NOT NULL to json_agg to prevent null-row phantom assignees

tasks.title: Preserve proof_url history before recurring duty reset
tasks.description: When HOD approves a recurring duty, the approval query NULLs out submission_text and proof_url immediately, destroying all evidence. Fix: before resetting, insert a cycle history record into a new academic_duty_cycle_history table, then reset. HOD ReviewPanel shows past cycle history.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: After approving a recurring cycle, the submission_text and proof_url from that cycle are stored in cycle history and visible to HOD. Faculty submission resets to Pending for next cycle.
tasks.commit_msg: feat(academic-duties): save cycle history before resetting recurring duty submission

tasks.title: Move ReviewPanel out of <td> into full-width row
tasks.description: ReviewPanel is currently rendered inside the first <td> of the faculty table row, breaking table layout. Fix: render it as a separate <tr> that spans all columns below the faculty row using colSpan.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: ReviewPanel renders in a full-width row below the faculty row. Table layout is not distorted.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(academic-duties): move ReviewPanel into full-width colspan row below faculty table row
